sn51.15:1.3: The follow-up to Uṇṇābha’s conversion in this discourse is at [sn48.42]().
sn51.15:1.6: “Desire” is _chanda_, rendered as “enthusiasm” in the context of the bases of psychic power.
sn51.15:4.2: This logical problem with Buddhist philosophy is commonly raised today.
sn51.15:4.4: Thew four items here correspond to the four bases of psychic power, but they must be rendered differently for coherence.
sn51.15:4.5: Here too _chanda_ is “desire”. It could have been rendered, “Have you ever felt enthusiastic about walking to the park?”
sn51.15:4.11: “Idea” is _citta_, normally “mind”, or “mental development” in the context of the bases of psychic power.
